help.title: How to Play
help.subtitle: Complete guide for hosts and players

forHost.title: For the Host (Projector)
forHost.intro: The host runs the game on a large screen or projector. One person from the team needs a laptop or computer.

step1.title: 1. Open the Host Page
step1.description: Go to the site and click "Start Game (Host)" or open /play/host directly. You'll see the difficulty selection screen.

step2.title: 2. Choose Difficulty
step2.description: Select the difficulty level: Easy (famous characters like Moses, David), Medium (prophets and apostles), Hard (experts only), or Mixed (combination of all levels).

step3.title: 3. Open the Lobby
step3.description: Click "Open Lobby". A QR code and game code (5 characters) will appear. Show this screen on the projector.

step4.title: 4. Wait for Players
step4.description: As players scan the QR code and enter their names, you'll see them appear in the lobby. Wait until everyone joins.

step5.title: 5. Start the Game
step5.description: Click "Start Quiz". The first question is a practice round (no points), then 10 questions follow, 15 seconds each.

step6.title: 6. After the Game
step6.description: Results are shown automatically. Click "New Game" to start another round with the same or different players.

forPlayer.title: For Players (Phone)
forPlayer.intro: Players join from their phones. No app needed — just a browser and internet.

step1.title: 1. Scan the QR Code
step1.description: Point your phone camera at the QR code on the big screen. Tap the notification to open the link.

step2.title: 2. Enter Your Name
step2.description: Type your name or nickname (at least 2 characters). This is how you'll appear on the leaderboard.

step3.title: 3. Wait in the Lobby
step3.description: You'll see "You're in the game" and wait for the host to start. Keep your phone ready!

step4.title: 4. Answer Questions
step4.description: When a question appears, tap one of the four colored buttons (A, B, C, D). Faster correct answers = more points!

step5.title: 5. See Your Results
step5.description: After each question, you'll see if you were correct and your current ranking. Final results appear at the end.

tips.title: Tips
tips.tip1: Make sure everyone is connected to the same WiFi or has mobile internet.
tips.tip2: The host device should not go to sleep during the game.
tips.tip3: Questions don't repeat for 24 hours — play multiple rounds without seeing the same images!
tips.tip4: If you get disconnected, scan the QR code again — you'll rejoin with the same name.

q1.q: I scanned the QR code but see a QR code screen
q1.a: You might have opened the Host page. Players should scan the QR code shown on the projector, which leads to the Play page. The URL should contain "?game=" with a 5-character code.

q2.a: Someone already joined with that name. Choose a different name or add a number (like "John2").

q3.a: Make sure the host page is open and hasn't gone to sleep. The game code should match what you see on screen.

q4.a: Scan the QR code again. If you used the same name, you'll automatically rejoin the game.
